ev.q: Billions is a complex drama about power politics
inspired by real-life federal prosecutions of financial crime
Despite a lack of likable characters
Anchored by the performances of Paul Giamatti and Damian Lewis
Shrewd, savvy U.S. Attorney Chuck Rhoades
The show's coverage of the hedge fund industry has been widely recognized as realistic
its seventh and final season premiered on August 13, 2023
